hypothesis: A pre-registered hypothesis under test, not an edge claim. US-domiciled holders of hedged foreign equity re-size their currency hedges at the month-end WM/R 16:00 London fix in proportion to month-to-date foreign-vs-US equity performance (Melvin & Prins, JFM 2015); dealers pre-hedge, so on the last business day the foreign currency moves against the hedgers' required trade between the European morning and the fix. Sign fixed in advance: foreign equity outperformance -> foreign currency falls vs USD 10:00-15:57 London.
rules: Event day D = last Monday-Friday of each calendar month (UK bank holidays not adjusted: no UK calendar in the manifest; an event on a UK holiday is kept as noise). Signal S_D = [GLSTOCK(T1)/GLSTOCK(M0) - 1] - [USLCAP(T1)/USLCAP(M0) - 1] from daily_assets_1970_2026, where M0 = last row dated in the previous calendar month and T1 = last row dated strictly before D; both rows must carry obs flag 1, else no trade. If S_D > 0 (foreign equity outperformed US equity month-to-date) the foreign currency is SOLD (short EURUSD, GBPUSD, AUDUSD); if S_D < 0 it is BOUGHT; S_D = 0 or missing: no trade. Clock: all times Europe/London, converted to UTC per day with zoneinfo, applied to HistData bars whose ts is bar-open UTC (manifest note: clock ny_dst converted). ENTRY at the open of the 10:00 London 1m bar; EXIT at the open of the 15:57 London 1m bar (before the 15:57:30-16:02:30 WM/R window). A pair-event is skipped if the 09:55-15:57 London span has more than 10 missing 1m bars or the entry/exit bar is missing (no forward fill). Fill price = bar open (bid) adjusted by the per-side cost below. Per-event P&L = sum over pairs of signed return x pair weight. No stops, no targets.
parameters: entry 10:00 London; exit 15:57 London; signal threshold 0; pairs EURUSD, GBPUSD, AUDUSD; signal assets GLSTOCK minus USLCAP (MTD to T1)
instruments: FTMO EURUSD, GBPUSD, AUDUSD CFDs (tested on HistData 1m bid spot)
holding: about 6 hours intraday, flat before the fix; 12 events/yr x 3 pairs
vol_scaler: Per pair weight w_p = (0.10/sqrt(252)) / sigma_p, sigma_p = EWMA (centre of mass 60 days) s.d. of daily 17:00 New York close-to-close log returns computed through the close before D; weights then divided by 3 (equal risk across the three pairs); no cap/floor.
cost_model: 1x floors per briefs/00-common.md (CFD FX 0.5-1.5 bp per side): 1.0 bp per side EURUSD, 1.2 bp GBPUSD, 1.5 bp AUDUSD applied at entry and exit on top of the bid-to-bid return (HistData is bid-only, so the spread is not in the data); no swap (flat intraday). 2x run attached (all per-side costs doubled). VENUE SENSITIVITY (pre-specified, no count, reported beside the headline, used for futures-firm economics): same P&L stream at CME 6E/6B/6A: 1 tick + $2.50 commission per side; the twin row proposed for that venue was withdrawn before registration because it reads the same data.
decision_rule: Gate v2 on the OOS window only, one read through qe.gateway.load(id,'oos'): pass iff (1) one-sided t of the net-1x per-event P&L (day-clustered; stationary/day-cluster bootstrap >= 430,000 draws) >= 3.6807; (2) net-2x mean > 0 (criterion 3); (3) criteria 4 and 7 of PARAMETERS.md (years, concentration, terciles, +-25% neighbours on entry/exit times or thresholds, one-bar delay) pass; (4) Red Team and re-implementation sign-off; (5) hold-out read in the restated one-sided tolerance form with h = decay_haircut. Anything else is 'refuted' or 'near-miss' (near-miss = t >= 2.0 with criterion 3 passed); the result file prints criterion-4 power and the joint figure for its own OOS length.
notes: Source: candidates.md rank 3 (AF C-1-04, absorbs A-C06), signed Melvin-Prins variant chosen by the Dept E pre-screen. EVIDENCE WINDOW: Melvin & Prins 2015 and Ito-Yamada 2018 end about 2013 (candidates.md; verify); Krohn-Mueller-Whelan (BoC SWP 2021-48, fetched 2026-11-06, p.30) tested the UNSIGNED pattern Jan 1999-Dec 2019 and report it is NOT driven by an end-of-month equity-hedging channel (no month-end intensification) - adverse, and it does not display the signed conditional, so this row is not derivative of KMW; OOS 2015-03..2024-12 is untouched by the signed evidence. Institutional change dates: 2015-02-15 (WM/R window 1 -> 5 minutes; IS ends before it, OOS starts after), 2018-01-03 (MiFID II; FX Global Code 2017-05 on pre-hedging) inside OOS, reported as a sub-period. OOS 9.8 years: bar 1.18 annual Sharpe; criterion-4 power 0.84/1.00/1.00 at true Sharpe 1.5/2.0/2.4; joint (criteria 3+4+7, costs 1/3 of gross) about 0.70/0.85/0.90. Realistic: 7 bp after haircut per pair-event vs about 35 bp s.d. over 6 h, 3 correlated pairs -> annual Sharpe about 0.8 -> expected t about 2.6, power about 0.2. Economics: gross after haircut 5-10 bp vs CFD round trip 2-3 bp = 2-4x (3x needed for criterion 3). Red Team strongest objection: KMW's appendix finds no month-end effect in exactly these pairs to 2019, and GLSTOCK contains US equity (about 60%), so S_D is a diluted proxy of foreign-minus-US performance; answered only by the test (sign fixed, one configuration). Firm: FTMO funded news rule (no open/close within 2 min of high-impact releases) not touched at 10:00/15:57 London except rare UK/EU releases - the engine skips an entry/exit inside any +-2 min high-impact window (calendar to be supplied by Dept C; until then logged). Venue twin: Q-0002 (same rule, CME futures costs). Hold-out read needs HistData 2025-2026 (free, to be landed under DATA_ROOT/holdout).
